verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs show that a single account-information consent token returns accounts and balances, and the same consent is used to pull transactions. So one authorisation can feed several data endpoints (balances, transactions, account details). However, nothing shows identity or account-ownership checks or payments running off that same session, and payments have their own authorisation endpoints. Missing for 10: evidence that identity/ownership verification shares the AIS consent, explicit docs describing one consent spanning multiple products, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
